claims.claim_text: The indexed Willard E Paxton is linked at high confidence to the official Army record.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The index and official Army bulk record agree on the exact name and a nonshared protected identifier.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High confidence from exact official name-and-identifier agreement.
claims.temporal_assessment: The records establish wartime Army identity, not a named pre-OSS employer.
claims.match_notes: The Army entry grade and coded occupation are not converted into employer evidence.

claims.claim_text: The indexed Oliver H Paxton III has a protected-identifier match to an Army record spelling the surname Paxson.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The protected identifier and given names agree, but the index prints Paxton, III while the Army record reads Paxson and omits the suffix.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Conflicting spelling: strong identifier evidence is preserved without silently replacing the indexed surname or suffix.
claims.temporal_assessment: The records establish a wartime identity lead but no named pre-OSS employer.
claims.match_notes: Box 591 review is required before resolving Paxton versus Paxson; coded occupation data are withheld.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The visually verified index and official Army bulk record agree on Willard E Paxton and a nonshared protected identifier. The Army record establishes identity only, not a named employer.
person_updates.next_action: Inspect Box 591 for Willard E Paxton's pre-OSS chronology and named civilian employer, if documented.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The protected identifier agrees, but the visually verified index prints Oliver H Paxton III while the official Army bulk record reads Oliver H Paxson and omits the suffix.
person_updates.next_action: Inspect Box 591 and compare the original personnel file with Army bulk ordinal 4333520 before resolving Paxton versus Paxson or the suffix.

person_updates.identity_evidence: Exact-name and accented-name searches found a French railway worker and resistance member named Francisque Paye or Paye, but no source links that person to the indexed S/Lt, OSS, Box 591, or another corroborating identifier.
person_updates.next_action: Inspect Box 591 for Francisque Paye's full name, nationality, unit, OSS relationship, and any documented pre-OSS occupation or employer.

person_updates.identity_evidence: Exact-name OSS, military, obituary, employment, directory, and archival searches returned several George A Payne namesakes but no Captain, protected-identifier, Box 591, or OSS bridge.
person_updates.next_action: Inspect Box 591 for George A Payne's identity, military chronology, and last civilian employer before wartime service.

person_updates.identity_evidence: Exact-name OSS, obituary, employment, directory, newspaper, and archival searches did not distinguish June W Payne from namesakes or establish pre-OSS chronology.
person_updates.next_action: Inspect Box 591 for June W Payne's identity, personnel status, occupation, and pre-OSS employer or affiliation.

person_updates.identity_evidence: A cemetery-derived result names a U.S. Army Captain Valentine Payne, but it supplies no protected identifier, OSS reference, Box 591 link, or pre-OSS chronology; the candidate remains unverified.
person_updates.next_action: Inspect Box 591 to determine whether the indexed Captain is the cemetery candidate and document military and civilian chronology.

person_updates.identity_evidence: Exact-name OSS, federal employment, obituary, directory, newspaper, and archival searches did not uniquely identify the indexed CAF-4 employee.
person_updates.next_action: Inspect Box 591 for Virginia A Payne's civilian personnel records, pre-OSS employer, and recruitment chronology.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The prominent MIT engineer Henry M Paynter was born in 1923, graduated in 1944, and worked for Puget Power in 1944-1946; that chronology does not bridge him to the indexed Major and the namesake is rejected.
person_updates.next_action: Inspect Box 591 for Major Henry M Paynter's full identity, unit, age, and pre-OSS chronology before considering any namesake biography.

person_updates.identity_evidence: Exact-name OSS, federal employment, obituary, directory, newspaper, and archival searches did not uniquely identify the indexed P-3 employee.
person_updates.next_action: Inspect Box 591 for Jane Payson's identity, P-3 duties, prior employer or student status, and recruitment chronology.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The index supplies only surname Pcheny, an asterisk as the first-name field, and the note no first n. Exact and variant searches cannot safely resolve a person from that incomplete record.
person_updates.next_action: Inspect Box 591 to recover Pcheny's full indexed identity, nationality, personnel status, and pre-OSS chronology without treating the asterisk as a name.

person_updates.identity_evidence: Exact-name searches did not establish Natica Peabody's identity. Natica Satterthwaite and other rare-given-name results use different surnames and lack an OSS or Box 591 bridge.
person_updates.next_action: Inspect Box 591 for Natica Peabody's identity, name history, wartime status, and pre-OSS employer or affiliation.
